faqs.q: What are the Oteco Model 72 gate valve repair kits?
faqs.a: These are minor and major repair kits for Oteco Model 72 gate valves from 2 to 5 inches, in standard (NBR), stainless-insert, low-temperature and sour gas versions, with standard or bonded gate packing. The listing holds 126 Oteco part numbers. They rebuild the valve in line. See [all gate valve repair kits and parts](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits).

faqs.q: How are Oteco Model 72 repair kit part numbers and Fits entries organised?
faqs.a: Kits are listed by valve model in a Fits column, written without the GV prefix, such as 224, or 236 and 250 together. The 236 and 250 share a kit, as do 336 and 350, and the 5-inch valves use the 4-inch kits. Part numbers such as IH-OTC-120012 are Minor Repair Kit, 224 Gate Valve (NBR/SS).

faqs.q: Do Oteco Model 72 repair kits fit Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal gate valves?
faqs.a: Oteco states that Model 72 gate valve parts are interchangeable with Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal valve parts. That is the maker's own statement, so we check the valve model and Oteco part number before confirming a part. Match by Oteco part number or Model 72 valve model, and see the valves they fit: [2-inch Model 72 valves](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-2-inch), [3-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-3-inch), [4-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-4-inch) and [5-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-5-inch).

faqs.q: Which Oteco Model 72 repair kit do I need for a GV436 or GV450 valve?
faqs.a: Kits follow the valve model, so a GV436 or GV450 takes a kit listed with 436, 450 in its Fits column; 5-inch models GV536 and GV550 use the same 4-inch kits. Choose minor or major, then the service and packing type. Send us the nameplate and we confirm the Oteco part number.

faqs.q: How do I choose between standard, sour gas, low-temperature and bonded Oteco Model 72 kits?
faqs.a: Match the kit to the valve trim: standard service, sour gas (H2S), or low-temperature, in NBR, HNBR, Viton or nitrile-LT with stainless parts as listed. BD and bonded-packing kits use bonded gate packing, with the wear plates moulded into the packing. Use the same packing style your valve was built with, and ask us if unsure.

faqs.q: What seal materials do Oteco Model 72 repair kits use?
faqs.a: Kit descriptions in the listing include NBR with stainless parts, HNBR and stainless, Viton and stainless, and Nitrile-LT and stainless for low-temperature service. Sour gas (H2S) kits are listed separately from standard-service kits, so the material in your kit follows the service stated in its Oteco description.

faqs.q: What approvals does Oteco state for Model 72 repair kits?
faqs.a: Oteco's literature for the Model 72 repair kits describes parts, fit and materials and makes no third-party approval claim. Oteco Inc. holds ISO 9001 certification as a company. Ask us for the maker's documentation when you order, and tell us if your project needs specific paperwork so we can check what is available.

faqs.q: What is in a minor and a major Oteco Model 72 repair kit?
faqs.a: A minor repair kit holds gate packings, wear plates and O-rings, the parts that seal the gate. A major repair kit is the minor kit plus the gate and the stem packing. For items beyond the kit, see [Model 72 spare parts](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-spare-parts) and [Model 72 body subs](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-body-subs).

faqs.q: Can the Oteco Model 72 gate valve be rebuilt in line with a repair kit?
faqs.a: Yes, Oteco's minor and major repair kits are designed to rebuild the valve in line. Interlocking gate packings and wear plates seal the gate and protect the body and cap. Kits are listed by valve model, size and service, so check your nameplate before ordering.

faqs.q: What is the difference between an Oteco Model 72 minor and a BD bonded kit?
faqs.a: A minor kit uses gate packings and wear plates as separate parts. A BD kit uses bonded gate packing, with the wear plates moulded into the packing, which Oteco lists as an option on Model 72. Both come as minor or major kits, so the choice depends on which packing your valve is built with.

faqs.a: Oteco makes Model 72 repair kits in Houston, Texas, USA, and the country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East and supplies the maker's documentation and part numbers with each order.

faqs.q: Do you stock Oteco Model 72 repair kits in Dubai?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco Model 72 repair kits in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the valve model, size, service and trim (or the Oteco part number from the kit or nameplate) for a quote. [Request a quote](/quote).

faqs.q: What are Oteco Model 72 gate valve body subs?
faqs.a: Body subs are the threaded, butt-weld, hammer-union and flanged end pieces that set the end connections on an Oteco Model 72 gate valve, and this listing holds 152 Oteco part numbers for 2 to 5-inch valves. Because the ends screw into the body, a valve changes connection by changing its two subs. See [gate valve repair kits and parts](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits).

faqs.q: How are Oteco Model 72 body sub descriptions and Fits entries read?
faqs.a: Each sub is listed with its connection and service, such as the butt-weld body sub IH-OTC-120101, 3" butt weld, Sch. XXS, sour gas service, which fits 336 and 350. The Fits column gives the Model 72 valve models, written without the GV, each part is listed for.

faqs.q: Do Oteco Model 72 body subs interchange with Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal subs?
faqs.a: Oteco states that Model 72 gate valve parts are interchangeable with Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal valve parts. That is the maker's own statement, so we check the valve model and Oteco part number before confirming a part. For a sub, also give the end connection, size and service so we can pick the right part.

faqs.q: What end connection types do Oteco Model 72 body subs cover?
faqs.a: Threaded subs cover line pipe, EUE, NUE and casing threads. Butt-weld subs come in Sch. 80, 160 and XXS with a 37.5° bevel to ASME B36.10 schedules. Union subs are male and female Figure 602, 1002 and 1502, and flanged subs are API ring-joint and ASME raised-face flanges, some xylan coated.

faqs.q: Do I need to change one or both Oteco Model 72 body subs to change the end connection?
faqs.a: A Model 72 valve has two subs, one at each end, and it moves to a new connection by changing them, not the body. Order the sub for each end with the connection, the valve model in the Fits column and the service. For a different connection on each end, we match two different subs.

faqs.q: Which Oteco Model 72 body subs are sour gas service or xylan coated?
faqs.a: Subs are listed with their service, so sour gas (H2S) subs such as the Sch. XXS 3" butt-weld sub IH-OTC-120101 are separate part numbers from standard ones. Some flanged subs are xylan coated. Give the service when you ask for a quote so we match the right sub.

faqs.q: What approvals does Oteco state for Model 72 body subs?
faqs.a: Oteco's literature for the Model 72 body subs describes parts, fit and materials and makes no third-party approval claim. Oteco Inc. holds ISO 9001 certification as a company. Ask us for the maker's documentation when you order, and tell us if your project needs specific paperwork so we can check what is available.

faqs.q: Which Oteco Model 72 valves do these body subs fit?
faqs.a: The subs fit the Model 72 valves listed in their Fits column: [2-inch Model 72 valves](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-2-inch), [3-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-3-inch), [4-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-4-inch) and [5-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-5-inch). Repair kits are on [Model 72 repair kits](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-repair-kits) and other parts on [Model 72 spare parts](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-spare-parts).

faqs.q: How are Oteco hammer-union body subs matched to unions?
faqs.a: Union subs are male and female Figure 602, 1002 and 1502, made to mate with FMC Weco unions. Oteco warns against connecting them to unions of other makes unless those are confirmed compatible (Oteco Engineering Bulletin EB-004). Check the figure number on both halves before ordering.

faqs.q: Which Oteco Model 72 body sub do I need to weld a 4-inch valve into a line?
faqs.a: For welding, choose a butt-weld sub in the right schedule: the listing has 4" butt weld in Sch. 160 and Sch. XXS for 436 and 450 valves, for example. Butt-weld subs carry a 37.5° bevel to ASME B36.10 schedules. Give the pipe schedule and service and we confirm the part.

faqs.q: Where are Oteco Model 72 body subs made?
faqs.a: Oteco makes the Model 72 body subs in Houston, Texas, USA, and the country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East, with the maker's documentation and part numbers.

faqs.q: Do you stock Oteco Model 72 body subs in Dubai?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco Model 72 body subs in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the valve model, connection and service, or the Oteco part number, for a quote. [Request a quote](/quote).

faqs.q: What are the Oteco Model 72 gate valve spare parts?
faqs.a: This listing holds 282 Oteco part numbers for replacement parts on 2 to 5-inch Model 72 gate valves: valve bodies, body caps, split bonnets, handwheels, stem nuts and bearing races, gates, wear plates, gate and stem packings, O-rings, studs and nuts. See [gate valve repair kits and parts](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits).

faqs.q: How do I find the Oteco Model 72 spare part number for my valve?
faqs.a: Each part is listed with a description and a Fits column naming the Model 72 valve models, written without the GV, such as 224 or 236, 250. Example: IH-OTC-120233 is a gate for sour gas or waterflood service in SS, fitting 336 and 350. Quote the model and part name and we confirm.

faqs.q: Are Oteco Model 72 spare parts interchangeable with Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal parts?
faqs.a: Oteco states that Model 72 gate valve parts are interchangeable with Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal valve parts. That is the maker's own statement, so we check the valve model and Oteco part number before confirming a part. Quote the valve model and the part name when you ask.

faqs.q: Which gate and wear plate materials do Oteco Model 72 spares come in?
faqs.a: Gates come in 4130 electroless nickel plated steel for standard service and stainless steel for sour gas and waterflood service. Wear plates are carburised 1026 steel or stainless. Choose the gate and wear plates to match the trim your valve was built with.

faqs.q: Which packings are listed among the Oteco Model 72 spare parts?
faqs.a: Stem packings and gate packings are listed in standard nitrile and low-temperature nitrile, with sour gas versions and bonded packings, such as IH-OTC-120291, Bonded Packing, Nitrile-LT and SS, for LT and SG service, fitting 436 and 450. Pick the packing by service and valve model.

faqs.q: What do Oteco Model 72 spare parts for sour gas or waterflood service use?
faqs.a: Sour gas (H2S) and waterflood spares are listed in stainless steel, for example a stainless gate, wear plates and a sour gas valve body such as IH-OTC-120224. Standard-service parts are listed separately, so state the service when you order.

faqs.q: What approvals does Oteco state for Model 72 spare parts?
faqs.a: Oteco's literature for the Model 72 spare parts describes parts, fit and materials and makes no third-party approval claim. Oteco Inc. holds ISO 9001 certification as a company. Ask us for the maker's documentation when you order, and tell us if your project needs specific paperwork so we can check what is available.

faqs.q: Which valves, kits and subs go with Oteco Model 72 spare parts?
faqs.a: The spares fit the Model 72 valves named in their Fits column: [2-inch Model 72 valves](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-2-inch), [3-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-3-inch), [4-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-4-inch) and [5-inch](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-5-inch). For a full rebuild see [Model 72 repair kits](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-repair-kits), and for connection changes see [Model 72 body subs](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-body-subs).

faqs.q: What is the best way to order a Model 72 handwheel, stem nut or stud?
faqs.a: Quote the valve model, such as 224, and the part name. Handwheels, stem nuts and bearing races, studs and nuts are listed individually, for example IH-OTC-126222, Stem Nut for Gate Valve, Standard Service, and IH-OTC-301180, Bearing Race for Stem Nut, both for 224. A few parts such as nuts have no Fits entry, so send the nameplate.

faqs.q: Should I buy a repair kit or individual Oteco Model 72 spare parts?
faqs.a: A minor repair kit holds gate packings, wear plates and O-rings, and a major kit adds the gate and stem packing, so a kit suits a routine rebuild. Individual spares suit a single worn or damaged part, such as a body cap or split bonnet. See [Model 72 repair kits](/p/oteco-model-72-gate-valve-repair-kits).

faqs.q: What are the Oteco DM gate valve repair kits?
faqs.a: These are minor and major repair kits for Oteco DM gate valves from DM 22 to DM 58, listed by body and trim: SD standard, SS stainless inserts, SG sour gas, CS cold service and HP 7,500 psi. The listing holds 26 Oteco part numbers. See [gate valve repair kits and parts](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits).

faqs.q: How do I pick the Oteco DM kit body: DM25, DM35, DM38 HP, DM45 or DM48 HP?
faqs.a: Oteco lists the kit by body: DM25 kit for models 22, 23 and 25; DM35 for 35; DM38 HP for 28 and 38; DM45 for 45 and 55; DM48 HP for 48 and 58. For example IH-OTC-160120 is a Minor Repair Kit for a 2" Standard Service DM valve, fitting DM 25.

The valves are on [DM valves with 2-inch ends](/p/oteco-dm-gate-valve-2-inch), [3-inch](/p/oteco-dm-gate-valve-3-inch), [4-inch](/p/oteco-dm-gate-valve-4-inch) and [5-inch](/p/oteco-dm-gate-valve-5-inch).

faqs.q: Which Oteco DM repair kit suits a 3-inch DM 35 or DM 38 valve?
faqs.a: For a 3" standard service DM 35, the listing has minor kits IH-OTC-160130 (SS/NBR) and IH-OTC-160131 (NBR) and major kits IH-OTC-160132 and IH-OTC-160140. The DM 38 uses sour gas kits IH-OTC-160136 and IH-OTC-160139, or the 160236 low-temperature kit.

faqs.q: Which Oteco DM repair kit suits a 4-inch DM 45 or DM 48 valve?
faqs.a: For a 4" DM 45, the listing has standard kits IH-OTC-160141 (minor) and IH-OTC-160142 (major) and sour gas kits IH-OTC-160143 and IH-OTC-160144. The DM 48 has kits including IH-OTC-160147 (minor, standard), IH-OTC-160148 (major, standard) and IH-OTC-160246 (low-temperature sour gas minor).

faqs.q: What seals do Oteco DM repair kits use for sour gas and standard service?
faqs.a: Standard service kits are listed in NBR or SS/NBR, and sour gas kits in SS, with low-temperature sour gas minor kits for DM 38 and DM 48. Match the kit to the service and trim named in its Oteco description.

faqs.q: What approvals does Oteco state for DM repair kits?

Ask us for the maker's documentation when you order, and tell us if your project needs specific paperwork so we can check what is available.

faqs.q: What is in a minor and a major Oteco DM repair kit?
faqs.a: A minor kit holds the gate, seat and bonnet seal. A major kit is the minor kit plus the stem, stem seals, stem screw, stem-screw seal and retainer seal; the 4-inch major kit adds the retainer, bearings, down-stop ring and Woodruff key. Other parts are on [DM spare parts](/p/oteco-dm-gate-valve-spare-parts).

faqs.q: Can I rebuild an Oteco DM gate valve in line with a repair kit?
faqs.a: Yes, the DM is a low-cost, in-line repairable gate valve, and minor and major kits rebuild it in line. Choose the kit by body and trim, then minor or major depending on whether the stem and stem seals need replacing as well as the gate, seat and bonnet seal.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Oteco DM SD, SS and HP kits?
faqs.a: SD is standard trim, SS has stainless seat inserts, SG is sour gas, CS is cold service and HP is the 7,500 psi high-pressure trim. The kit is listed by body and trim, so choose the one that matches your valve's trim, not just its size.

faqs.q: What gate and seat materials do Oteco DM spare parts come in?
faqs.a: Gates are 316 stainless (CF8M) for the 5,000 psi valves and 17-4 PH for the 7,500 psi valves. Seats are NBR 70 or HNBR 80 on steel or stainless inserts, for example IH-OTC-161723, a seat with stainless inserts for standard service (NBR), fitting DM 25.

faqs.q: What DM valve bodies are listed among the Oteco DM spare parts?

Send the model and end connection and we confirm the body.

faqs.q: Which Oteco DM spares are for sour gas (H2S) or cold service?
faqs.a: Sour gas parts are listed separately, such as IH-OTC-161739 (seat, stainless inserts, sour gas HNBR, for DM 38), IH-OTC-161446 (4" sour gas bonnet for DM 45) and IH-OTC-160337 (3" sour gas gate for DM 38). Low-temperature seats use HNBR, for example IH-OTC-161747 for DM 48.
